Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

IS: 6129- 1971 

2*1 Tolerances on Width Across Flats — As specified for forged and subsequently machined spanners in 
IS: 2027- 1 967 'Widths across flats for spanners (first revision)'. 

3. tiaterlal — Steels which fulfil the requirements laid down in 4. 

3.1 Suitable steels are 2ICrlMo28 and 5-0CrlV23 as specified in IS: 1570-1961 * Schedules for wrought steels 
for general engineering purposes'. 

4, Hardness, Test and Other Requirements — According to IS:6I31-197I 'Technical requirements 
for hand operated wrenches (spanners) and sockets' {under print). The torque test shall conform to 
Series AoflS:6i3l-l97l. 

5» Designation — A square box wrench of 30 mm nomimal width across flats shall be designated as: 

Wrench 30 IS: 6129 

6. Marking — The wrenches shall be marked with the nominal width across flats, and the manufacturer's 
initials or trade-mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, Mew Delhi L
